test_title: PYST 2: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: H, I, J, K, U, V and W are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. Only four people sit between U and V when counted from the right of U. U sits third to the left of W. K sits third to the left of H. I is an immediate neighbour of both V and W. How many people sit between J and I when counted from the right of J?
solution:
Given: H, I, J, K, U, V and W are sitting around a circular table facing the center of the table.

1) Only four people sit between U and V when counted from the right of U.

2) U sits third to the left of W.

3) K sits third to the left of H.

4) I is an immediate neighbour of both V and W.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e913264330f6051d71e0daf2ba14399cecd447f73634f477bc3399abbbc9498a.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0c965de81a07caa1ab2fd1b73cde4cb19c9759a21e383c5e1ef86095ccf76da7.png] 

So, J will sit on the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6896a8f0590c227892b20b9e4112e147a4d36e6a9e7e2121c82485f2055c8cce.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a1bd2a4a96b9b73c6c7d73887975a9395b090848ee0327da01629d517fa58eb4.png] 

Here,2** **people sit between J and I when counted from the right of J

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
